vulnerability.explanation: When EVP_PKEY_get_default_digest_name() returns 2 with "UNDEF" (e.g., for Ed25519/Ed448 keys), dgst is set to NULL (lines 846–848). Later, if req is set and -verbose is used, BIO_printf is called with "%s" and dgst (line 871), passing a NULL pointer to a %s formatter and causing a NULL dereference.
